entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you with your VeloFit product today?

Finally! I've been trying to return this useless VeloBand for weeks and your company is making it impossible. This is my last attempt before I file a chargeback and light you up on every review site on the internet.

I can certainly understand your frustration, and I'm very sorry to hear you've had a difficult experience. I want to help get this sorted out. To start, could I get your name and order number, please?
The name is Tom Peterson. Order number is VF88-6-TANGO. And don't give me the runaround. I know it's been over a month. I'm not an idiot.

Thank you, Tom. I'm pulling up your order now... I see you received the VeloBand Cadence Sensor about 34 days ago. I want to make sure I understand the situation correctly. Is it a technical fault with the band, or is it more of a preference issue?

It's an issue with your company! I tried to return it on day nine! Day nine! I went to your website, and it was a complete joke. I kept getting a 'website error' message. The whole return portal was a total system down situation.
I see. I'm sorry you encountered that.

Sorry doesn't cut it! I couldn't print the label, I couldn't get a confirmation, nothing! I even took a screenshot of the error page to prove it. Now it's 34 days later and I expect a full refund. Get me your manager right now.

I understand your request for a manager, Tom, but I believe I can resolve this for you directly. That system down event you mentioned... I can actually see a note here about a known outage on our site around that time. I sincerely apologize for that inconvenience.
So you admit it was your fault! Good. Now process the refund before I lose my mind.
Let me just confirm the return eligibility for you. One moment... Okay, I've checked the policy for your VeloBand. It looks like you're well within the return window.
What? Don't play games with me. It's been 34 days.

No games at all, sir. Our policy allows for returns up to 10 days after delivery. Since you're only at day 34, you have plenty of time. I can process that return and email you a pre-paid shipping label right now.
Oh. Uh... ninety days? Seriously? I thought it was something like ten or twenty.

No, sir, it's 90. So, we're all set. I've just sent that label to the email on file. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your full refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Well... no. That's... that's it. Thank you.
You're very welcome, Tom. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a great rest of your day.
